limitations: Current ClickHouse-written manifests fail conformance; ch-direct/ch-archive full-size cases are not qualified.
Native serving stops one replica with retained volume; this is not disk loss, independent-host durability or a continuously observed production workload.
Resource observations include co-tenancy with the preserved idle historical storage; current trials were serial. CPU samples exclude unobserved startup/exit edges.
No cold OS cache or sustained/repeated capacity comparison; query-check timings include correctness execution at an already-used fixture.
File bytes before/after compaction are measured, but encoded column-chunk compression was not collected for these three normal-path snapshots. Recovery-snapshot compression is reported separately.
Allocated disk is per-service filesystem allocation; block read/write bytes and I/O counts are Docker-VM counters, not physical host SSD latency. Missing counters stay unavailable.

environment.scope: One Apple M4 Pro host, shared Docker VM; preserved historical storage remained running. CPU/memory settings are caps, not reserved independent machines.
